contributions.detail: +0.20 DELTA, RETAINED VERBATIM, NOTHING NUDGED. The 11 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 96.80 + 48.25 + 48.25 + 19.12 + 50.00 + 500.00 + 100.00 + 36.11 + 36.11 + 242.25 = 2,176.89, against a printed subtotal / printed schedule total / cover Column A of 2,177.09 — the filer's own stated figure exceeds the sum of his own itemized lines by exactly 0.20. HOW IT WAS TRACED, and why no row is named: (a) this sheet has ONE Schedule A page and its 'Subtotal for this page' equals its 'Total Contributions Received', so the page-subtotal gate and the schedule gate are the same gate and there is no second sheet whose subtotal could have been mis-added; (b) all 11 amount cells were escalated INDIVIDUALLY to 1200 dpi tight crops (this filing is TYPED, not handwritten — every glyph is unambiguous at that resolution) and every one reproduced exactly what is recorded, so no misread cell can absorb the 0.20 and there is no digit to correct: 96.80 is not 97.00, 19.12 is not 19.32, 242.25 is not 242.45, neither 36.11 is 36.21; (c) a 500 dpi full-width crop of rows 12-16 AND of the white space above the 'Subtotal for this page' label renders a wholly empty grid, so trap F1.5 (a ledger continuing below the last printed rule) does NOT explain it and no twelfth row exists; (d) the §A1 first-entry control and the §B5 one-past control both passed, so the row index is not shifted and nothing at either end is missing; (e) CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN: not-correlated-by-absence — Frost has exactly ONE filing in this corpus (index.csv), so there is no sibling report in which the same +0.20 could recur. The 0.20 is therefore the FILER'S OWN ARITHMETIC, a fact about the document, and the cover is internally consistent with it (763.15 + 2,177.09 = 2,940.24 = line 5; 2,940.24 - 1,602.14 = 1,338.10 = line 7, all as printed).
